messages:
Mia L: Heads up — we're getting multiple customer escalations: intermittent 504s from edge for long streaming requests in eu1 since ~2026-03-15 23:00 UTC. Tenants acme-inc & beta-ai.

Raj P: Can you paste sample trace ids / short repro?

Mia L: Trace ids: abcd1234, efgh5678. Quick repro command the customer ran: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --data-binary @prompt-large.json https://eu1.api.redwood.dev/v1/stream` (prompt-large.json ~150KB).

Tim SRE: Observed matching spikes on envoy: upstream_rx_reset reason=RST_STREAM, code=PROTOCOL_ERROR around same timestamps. Also saw `client_tls_early_data=1` in some logs.

Support Oncall: Pasted envoy snippet: `[envoy][2026-03-15T23:01:12Z] stream_id=12345 upstream_reset: RST_STREAM: PROTOCOL_ERROR; client_tls_early_data=1; upstream_host=10.0.3.5`

Mia L: Interesting — when customer disabled TLS early_data on client side the repro stopped. They said the issue started after last Friday's edge TLS perf change (PR #892).

Raj P: That PR enabled accepting TLS1.3 early_data + buffer coalescing at frontdoor. Hypothesis: early_data + large initial body + chunked streaming interacts poorly with nginx upstream and triggers a protocol error.

Tim SRE: I can flip ingress flag to refuse early_data on eu1 canary for 5m to test. If 504s drop we have a good signal.

infra-bot: action: deploy-toggle ingress-eu1-accept-early-data=false initiated by Tim SRE (run id: deploy-6429998890).

Support Oncall: Customer workaround provided: disable TLS early_data in client, or send smaller initial request chunk. Both are temporary. :thumbsup:

Mia L: Requesting packet captures for a repro window. I'll coordinate with acme-inc on a scheduled repro run. Need tcpdump from edge + upstream during test.

Raj P: Repro steps for infra once we have tenant cooperation: 1) create prompt.json ~150KB 2) `curl --http1.1 -v --data-binary @prompt.json -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://eu1.api.redwood.dev/v1/stream` with TLS early_data enabled 3) collect envoy logs + tcpdump on 10s window.

Tim SRE: After toggling off early_data on eu1 canary the 504 spike dropped to 0 for 30m. Rolling full rollback of PR-892 on edge and monitoring.

Mia L: Thanks — please post rollback ID and monitor dashboards (latency, 504 rate, upstream reset rate). I'll update the customers and open a follow-up incident for a postmortem.

Support Oncall: Notified acme-inc & beta-ai with workaround and ETA for rollback. Will follow up after monitoring window.

Tim SRE: Rollback completed to stable before PR-892 (rollback-id: rb-6429998899). Metrics look good so far.

Mia L: Great, leaving this open until we have tcpdumps + root cause. Adding @ProductLead for prioritization of a permanent fix.

Support Oncall: Marking for postmortem and tracking in follow-up ticket INFRA-2198.

Raj P: Note for postmortem: investigate edge TLS early_data acceptance path + buffer coalescing interactions with nginx upstream body parsing. Also check if any HTTP/2 framing differences are introduced when early_data is present.

Mia L: Ack. I'll assemble timelines and drop logs into the incident doc once tcpdumps arrive.
